question: Pila ang porsyento sa amilyar sa Basic Real Property Tax ug SEF nga gasingilin sa City Treasurer?
answer: Sa amilyar sa Basic Real Property Tax ug SEF (Special Education Fund) sa City Treasurer, ang gasingilin nga 1.5% ang Basic Real Property Tax [S1, S2, S3], at ang gasingilin nga 1% ang SEF [S1].

ground_truth: Annex11 states Basic Real Property Tax is 1.5% of assessed value and the additional Special Education Fund levy is 1% of assessed value. Their arithmetic sum is 2.5% of assessed value; this sum is derived from the two stated rates.
